findings.evidence: ⚠️ Unverified: runtime configuration was not exercised. Statically, _target_ref() reads the local refs/remotes/origin/HEAD ref without checking which repository origin points to. _trusted_commit() uses that ref to select a merge base, and _load_verifiers() imports and runs verifier code from that commit. docs/ci.md:556-557 notes that origin must be the canonical upstream, but the script does not enforce that condition.
findings.remediation: Before extracting or importing verifier code, verify that origin resolves to the configured canonical upstream and that the selected target ref belongs to it; exit 2 if the trusted remote cannot be established.

findings.evidence: The changed fixed path now records a disposition after resolving the thread, and fix-self-review.md:71 says to record one disposition per finding. The Issue and Decline paths at SKILL.md:280-323 do not record dispositions; the Decline path explicitly says there is no tracking artifact.
findings.remediation: Record the settled disposition on the Issue and Decline paths too, or narrow the ledger documentation and stated corpus purpose to the dispositions it actually records.
